guardrails.title: Guardrails
guardrails.description: Default Amazon Bedrock guardrail for deployed agents.
guardrails.environmentNote: This default comes from the LOOM_GUARDRAIL_* environment variables on the backend. Saving here overrides it.
guardrails.policiesNote: Block, mask, and detect behavior is configured on the guardrail itself in Amazon Bedrock. Loom only chooses which guardrail and version an agent uses, and how it is applied. Changes reach agents at their next deploy or redeploy.
guardrails.readOnlyNote: Only administrators can change the default guardrail.
guardrails.enabledHelper: Agents set to inherit the default get this guardrail
guardrails.modeHelper: Enforce attaches the guardrail to every model call. Monitor runs ApplyGuardrail on input and output and only logs the result.
guardrails.modeManagedNote: Managed (harness) agents support enforce only, and non-Bedrock providers support monitor only.
guardrails.streamAsyncNote: Bedrock can't mask sensitive information in async mode. Responses stream before the guardrail finishes checking them.
guardrails.redactHistoryNote: After an intervention, replace the offending turn in the conversation history so the session can continue.
guardrails.lockedNote: Agents can't choose None. A custom guardrail is still allowed, but it can't use monitor while the default enforces.
guardrails.configRequired: Select a guardrail and version to enable the default.
